text: CrowdStrike disclosed that a Falcon sensor configuration update released at 04:09 UTC on July 19, 2024 affected certain Windows systems and was reverted at 05:27 UTC.
textZh: CrowdStrike 披露，2024 年 7 月 19 日 04:09 UTC 发布的 Falcon 传感器配置更新影响了部分 Windows 系统，并于 05:27 UTC 回滚。

text: CrowdStrike stated that the event was caused by a defect in a Windows-host content update and was not a cyberattack; Mac and Linux hosts were not impacted.
textZh: CrowdStrike 表示，该事件由 Windows 主机内容更新缺陷引起，并非网络攻击；Mac 与 Linux 主机未受影响。

text: CrowdStrike's preliminary review scoped the affected population to Windows hosts running sensor version 7.11 or later that were online during the 04:09-05:27 UTC update window and received the update.
textZh: CrowdStrike 初步审查将受影响范围限定为：运行 7.11 或更高版本传感器、在 04:09 至 05:27 UTC 期间在线并接收该更新的 Windows 主机。

text: Microsoft estimated that the update affected 8.5 million Windows devices, less than one percent of all Windows machines.
textZh: Microsoft 估计该更新影响了 850 万台 Windows 设备，不到全部 Windows 设备的 1%。
limitations: The estimate is not mapped to financial loss, order flow, or price impact.

text: CrowdStrike's root-cause summary said the sensor expected 20 input fields while the update supplied 21, producing an out-of-bounds memory read and a system crash.
textZh: CrowdStrike 根因摘要称，传感器预期 20 个输入字段，而更新提供了 21 个，进而触发越界内存读取并造成系统崩溃。

text: CrowdStrike reported on August 6 that approximately 99% of Windows sensors were online as of 8:00 p.m. EDT on July 29, compared with the level before the update.
textZh: CrowdStrike 于 8 月 6 日报告称，截至 7 月 29 日美国东部时间 20:00，与更新前相比约 99% 的 Windows 传感器已经在线。
limitations: The issuer noted that normal sensor-connection variance is approximately one percent week over week.

text: For this simulation only, a bounded operational-outage signal increases uncertainty and risk-off action preferences without directly setting prices or orders.
textZh: 仅在本次仿真中，一条有界的运营故障信号提高不确定性与风险规避行动偏好，但不会直接设定价格或订单。

text: For this simulation only, a verified clarification signal narrows uncertainty after a configurable synthetic delay; it never sets a price, valuation, or trading decision.
textZh: 仅在本次仿真中，经核验的澄清信号会在可配置的合成延迟后降低不确定性；它不会设定价格、估值或交易决策。
